descriptions: This dataset contains 6 audio recordings (6 items) on the subject of Arab-Israeli relations in Egypt in the 1990s.
The interviews in this dataset are conducted in English and Arabic. The summaries of the interviews are rendered in English.

relations.text: Thematic collection: Data from the Center for Intercultural Dialogue and Translation (CIDT) and Stichting Arab-West Foundation (AWF). DOI: 10.17026/dans-22k-22dc

data_sources: All interviews were conducted by Cornelis Hulsman, Drs. and his colleagues at the Cairo Foreign Press Association. All interview summaries were prepared by interns at CIDT-CAWU.
